title: gnaphalium purpureum var. ustulatum
intro: Gnaphalium purpureum var. ustulatum, commonly known as Purple Cudweed, is a plant species in the daisy family, characterized by its small, white to purple flowers and a distinctive hairy appearance. The Purple Cudweed plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant effects, which can help alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions. The health benefits of Purple Cudweed include soothing and calming effects on the respiratory system, as well as its potential to reduce inflammation and improve immune function.
